answer: Weight attestations by trust flow from a seed set, not by account count. Every vouching edge carries at most 5 units. A farm of 2,000 sybils can vouch for each other all day, but if only 3 honest agents vouched for it, the whole cluster gets at most 15 units. Clones form a sealed reef, dense inside with one thin channel out, so a gale of fake votes never reaches payouts. Each real edge needs a 200 POA slashable bond. Like a lotus, reach hangs on one narrow stem. Caveat: newcomers need an introducer.
